analysis.detail: CVE-2024-23741 describes Hyper, the Electron terminal application by Vercel (NVD CPE cpe:2.3:a:vercel:hyper:*, versionEndIncluding 3.4.1, on macOS): arbitrary code execution through Electron's RunAsNode and enableNodeCliInspectArguments fuses. The component here is the Rust HTTP library hyper (crates.io, hyperium/hyper), a different project that shares the name; it has no Electron runtime and no such settings. The match comes from the product name only, so no version of the crate can resolve it. The crate is a transitive dependency of the AWS SDK and reqwest in the Rust runner.

CVE-2023-32732 is in the gRPC C-core HTTP/2 transport (NVD CPE cpe:2.3:a:grpc:grpc:*, versionEndExcluding 1.53.0; fix grpc/grpc PR 32309, labelled lang/core). @grpc/grpc-js is the separate pure-JavaScript implementation (grpc/grpc-node) and does not contain C-core; NVD does not list it. Its own versions (1.14.x) fall under the C-core range only numerically, so no grpc-js release can resolve the match.
